law_name: Law No. 35/2016 on Copyright and Other Related Rights (as amended by Law No. 37/2022)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous/pseudonymous works: 70 years from lawful disclosure)
orphan_works: Orphan works provisions (use procedure, termination of status, fair compensation)
digital_protection: Anti-circumvention ban on effective technological measures (art. 154); rights-management information protected (art. 155); voluntary measures protected under art. 154 (art. 87(4)); 2016 text
fair_use_exceptions: Exhaustive list (art. 70): private copying (art. 72), teaching and research (arts. 76, 79), disability (art. 77), quotation (art. 81); remuneration for private copying on devices and blank media; 2016 text
enforcement_body: Directorate for Copyright and Related Rights, Ministry of Culture
